W02

Auth return/recovery

/app/auth/return
Roles: guest, student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: P41

Resolve the institutional return into an authorized academic context or a recoverable sign-in failure. Never expose token values or raw provider errors.

Institution sign-in returnExpired session recovery from W13Cancelled or interrupted W01 handoff

Status panelVerifying identity, institution and requested destination; Plain-language reason and next action
Recovery panelRetry sign-in; change institution; technical help; Safe route fallback when original destination no longer exists

Permissions
  • Successful authentication alone grants no course access.
  • A consumed callback cannot create duplicate sessions or invitation acceptance.
  • Staff and learner landing choices use assigned roles only.
Responsive
  • One status card; recovery actions stack on narrow screens.
  • No layout shift from loading to error that hides the recovery heading.
Accessibility
  • Announce verification outcome once; move focus to the outcome heading.
  • Error reference is selectable text; never announce token or internal exception strings.
Data
  • Simulated verification outcome, safe destination, account and role summary.
  • Redacted correlation reference and institution support owner.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Expired callback opens a fresh W01 flow without a redirect loop.
  • Valid first use goes to W04 and retains the original return.
  • A guessed course URL still receives access checking after identity succeeds.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
  • HTML models outcomes; it does not validate real credentials or implement an auth protocol.
